source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    def intervals(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for x in cuts:
            if start < x:
                out.append((start, x))
            start = x + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rows = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    cols = intervals(w, sep_cols)
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in rows for c0, c1 in cols
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
    bg = max((color for color in counts if color not in sep_colors), key=lambda color: counts[color])
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] not in sep_colors
                    for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row_out.append(1 if n == 2 else bg)
        result.append(row_out)
    return result
'''
